description: High Tables, Cho-Han: prepare (unsigned) a bet on the current round: side 0 = cho (even), 1 = han (odd), amount in $ZENI (an approve, then the bet). Needs an Override Disk in the wallet. The dice come from a public drand draw nobody picks.

amountZeni.description: Amount in whole $ZENI (within the table's min and max).

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: prepare_cho_han_bet
